---
title: "Example: Todo List Application"
---



```{r, eval=TRUE, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
library(alpinejs)
library(htmltools)

app <- alpine_tag("div",
  class = "todo-container",
  style = "max-width: 600px; margin: 40px auto; font-family: sans-serif;",

  # Header
  alpine_tag("h1","Todo List", style = "color: #333; margin-bottom: 20px;"),

  # Input section
  alpine_tag("div",
    style = "display: flex; gap: 10px; margin-bottom: 20px;",
    alpine_tag("input",
      type = "text",
      placeholder = "What needs to be done?",
      style = "flex: 1; padding: 10px; border: 1px solid #ddd; border-radius: 4px;"
    ) |>
      alpine_model("newTodo", .trim = TRUE),
    alpine_tag("button",
      "Add",
      style = "padding: 10px 20px; background: #007bff; color: white; border: none; border-radius: 4px; cursor: pointer;"
    ) |>
      alpine_on("click", "addTodo()")
  ),

  # Filter tabs
  alpine_tag("div",
    style = "display: flex; gap: 10px; margin-bottom: 20px; border-bottom: 1px solid #eee; padding-bottom: 10px;",
    alpine_tag("button",
      "All",
      style = "background: none; border: none; cursor: pointer; padding: 8px; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent;"
    ) |>
      alpine_on("click", "filter = 'all'") |>
      alpine_bind("style", "filter === 'all' ? 'border-bottom-color: #007bff; color: #007bff;' : 'color: #777;'"),
    alpine_tag("button",
      "Active",
      style = "background: none; border: none; cursor: pointer; padding: 8px; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent;"
    ) |>
      alpine_on("click", "filter = 'active'") |>
      alpine_bind("style", "filter === 'active' ? 'border-bottom-color: #007bff; color: #007bff;' : 'color: #777;'"),
    alpine_tag("button",
      "Completed",
      style = "background: none; border: none; cursor: pointer; padding: 8px; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent;"
    ) |>
      alpine_on("click", "filter = 'completed'") |>
      alpine_bind("style", "filter === 'completed' ? 'border-bottom-color: #007bff; color: #007bff;' : 'color: #777;'")
  ),

  # Todo list
  alpine_for(
    alpine_tag("div",
      style = "display: flex; align-items: center; padding: 12px; border: 1px solid #eee; margin-bottom: 8px; border-radius: 4px; background: white;",

      # Checkbox
      alpine_tag("input",
        type = "checkbox",
        style = "margin-right: 12px; cursor: pointer; width: 20px; height: 20px;"
      ) |>
        alpine_bind("checked", "todo.completed") |>
        alpine_on("change", "todo.completed = $el.checked; saveTodos()"),

      # Todo text
      alpine_tag("span",
        style = "flex: 1;"
      ) |>
        alpine_text("todo.text") |>
        alpine_bind("style", "todo.completed ? 'text-decoration: line-through; color: #999;' : 'color: #333;'"),

      # Delete button
      alpine_tag("button",
        "×",
        style = "background: none; border: none; color: #dc3545; cursor: pointer; font-size: 24px; padding: 0; width: 30px; height: 30px;"
      ) |>
        alpine_on("click", "deleteTodo(todo.id)")
    ),
    "todo in filteredTodos()",
    key = "todo.id"
  ),

  # Stats
  alpine_tag("div",
    style = "margin-top: 20px; padding-top: 10px; border-top: 1px solid #eee; color: #666; font-size: 14px;",
    alpine_tag("span") |>
      alpine_text("'Active: ' + activeTodos() + ', Completed: ' + completedTodos()")
  )
) |>
  alpine_init("todos = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('todos') || '[]')") |>
  alpine_data(
    newTodo = "",
    todos = alpine_array(),
    filter = "all",

    # Methods
    addTodo = htmlwidgets::JS("
      function() {
        if (!this.newTodo.trim()) return;
        this.todos.push({
          id: Date.now(),
          text: this.newTodo,
          completed: false
        });
        this.newTodo = '';
        this.saveTodos();
      }
    "),

    deleteTodo = htmlwidgets::JS("
      function(id) {
        this.todos = this.todos.filter(t => t.id !== id);
        this.saveTodos();
      }
    "),

    saveTodos = htmlwidgets::JS("
      function() {
        localStorage.setItem('todos', JSON.stringify(this.todos));
      }
    "),

    filterTodos = htmlwidgets::JS("
      function(filterType) {
        if (filterType === 'active') {
          return this.todos.filter(t => !t.completed);
        } else if (filterType === 'completed') {
          return this.todos.filter(t => t.completed);
        }
        return this.todos;
      }
    "),

    filteredTodos = htmlwidgets::JS("
      function() {
        return this.filterTodos(this.filter);
      }
    "),

    activeTodos = htmlwidgets::JS("
      function() {
        return this.todos.filter(t => !t.completed).length;
      }
    "),

    completedTodos = htmlwidgets::JS("
      function() {
        return this.todos.filter(t => t.completed).length;
      }
    ")
  ) |>
  htmltools::browsable()

app
```
